craft_notes: Sthāyin: compatibility. Rows: unrefuted then stirred. Rejected: philosophers invention — killed: not in L3. Read aloud: broad seal.

lines: Thus by that the varied telling, even in Raurava and the rest, stands unrefuted;
but that very, become stirred, is the enjoyed-common: the strand-truth.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tena bhinnakramanirūpaṇam api rauravādiṣu śāstreṣu aviruddhaṃ mantavyaṃ tad eva tu bhogyasāmānyaṃ prakṣobhagataṃ guṇatattvam
